title: Ava M Probable NDE 838
content: I was driving home from my job as school librarian when I met a Fort Riley soldier who crossed the highway line and hit my car head-on. His small truck then went up onto the top of my car and over the right side. The driver was barely injured and walked, but I was almost killed. I don't remember the accident at all, but this is what the highway patrol who put the accident together told me.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: No Accident Life threatening event, but not clinical death
elements.At what time during the experience were: I don't remember anything about it.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes My husband told me that at one point in the hospital I was talking about angels.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I now believe in the afterlife and God.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: There was no best part. The worst part is that it happened.
